text:
GENERATE BURST CS-v4-2_0 — cliffside v4.1 chunk 2_0, a chunk with no painted neighbours yet, painted over its orthographic guide (Matt R-C3-54-57). task_id "CS-v4-2_0".

IMAGE 1 is a flat-shaded ORTHOGRAPHIC GEOMETRY GUIDE: OLIVE GREEN = grassy rocky ground on the cliff top (short grass, moss, small flowers, bare rock patches; NO boulders, NO props); TAN = a worn packed-dirt path/clearing inside the grass — its edges are ragged and soft, dirt breaking into grass with tufts and pebbles, never a clean line; LIGHT GREY band = the rocky verge right at the rim; GREY planes (dark grey with lighter ribs) = natural cliff faces dropping toward the viewer, with irregular fluting, buttresses and cracks — paint them as continuous weathered rock all the way down to where they meet the green, slightly hazier and darker toward their lowest part, with no ledge or bottom edge drawn; BROWN planks + posts = a wooden bridge deck; MAGENTA plank = one loose bridge plank (paint it as a cracked, loose plank); PURE GREEN #00ff00 = empty void.
Deliver ONE 1536×1024 painting that follows IMAGE 1 exactly: keep every boundary where it is; paint every green pixel as flat pure #00ff00; paint every other pixel as scenery.
Orthographic view: no perspective shrinking toward the top. Scale: a person standing here is 130 px tall. LIGHT: warm SUNSET key from the UPPER-LEFT, cool violet shadows. REGISTER: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D — confident tapered dark contours, painted planes, bold Hades-like jewel tones and graphic shadows — matching IMAGE 2 exactly. No characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if a painted strip was altered, a boundary moved, the green was painted over, or a join line remains — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/chunk_2_0.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-v4-2_0"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — GEOMETRY GUIDE (exact boundaries; green = void)
IMAGE 2 — the approved painted STYLE of this level (Matt: 'love the style and the chunks')
